title: Longest Substring of One Repeating Character
goal: After each character replacement, report the longest run of one repeated character.
strategy: Each segment-tree node stores its boundary characters, equal-character prefix and suffix lengths, and best internal run. A replacement changes one leaf and only the ancestors that contain it.

edgeCases: Updating a character to itself preserves the result
A one-character segment tree always reports one
Replacing a separator joins two equal runs
